NOT the 55.1% watch-roll stack (HTS 4202.92.97) - different chapter, different rate. VERIFY with a broker before a first commercial order.
verdict: HELD 2026-09-10 - transit, not economics. Cost, voltage, per-SKU stock, imagery and rule 2 all pass. The parcel does not: the SKU we sell ships on AliExpress Selection Shipping_OVERSIZED at 33-41 days to the United States, against 8-14 days on Selection Standard for every other approved offer. All of them quote the same $1.99, so freight cost concealed it. A US customer paying CA$144 and waiting five to six weeks is a refund and a dispute, and the product page does not disclose the window. See TRANSIT_HOLD_CATALOG_OFFERS in app/lib/launch-catalog.js.
